name: fa_online_softmax
desc: Single-warp FlashAttention forward microbench: the genuine online-softmax algorithm (running max m, running denominator l, rescale corr=exp(m_old-m_new) across KV tiles) with shared-memory K/V staging. SQ=32 query rows (one per lane), D=16, seqlen_k=64 (2 KV tiles). Uses only already-verified ops (FFMA dots, MUFU.EX2 __expf, FMNMX fmaxf, STS + BAR.SYNC smem staging) and NO warp-specialized TMA/WGMMA/mbarrier, so it lifts and runs unconditionally on the x86 backend (no env toggles). Isolates the FA online-softmax dataflow from the Hopper warp-spec machinery. Verified vs a CPU attention oracle.
gpu_ref: none (CPU attention oracle in host_cpu.cpp; no GPU on build host)
